kaikki_vikisozluk.e: قَعَّبَ • (qaʕʕaba) II (non-past يُقَعِّبُ (yuqaʕʕibu), verbal noun تَقْعِيب (taqʕīb))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Probably a biconsonantal origin seen as well in قَاع (qāʕ, “lowest part”).
g: to be cup-like, to impart depth in one's speech

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: قَعْب • (qaʕb) m (plural قِعَاب (qiʕāb) or أَقْعُب (ʔaqʕub))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Probably a biconsonantal origin seen as well in قَاع (qāʕ, “lowest part”).
g: A large vessel, a huge concave cup, that is sufficient for several people. It may satisfy one man’s thirst, or it may satisfy two or three people.
